recall_policy: Tie-aware against independently verified filtered exact top-k. Recall denominator is sum of min(k, eligible exact count); zero denominator uses vacuous recall 1, not measured retrieval quality.
limitations: Synthetic SplitMix64 f32, independent seeded queries, shared unpinned host, single sequential client, warm queries, no concurrent writes. Selective and empty predicates may traverse the whole reachable graph. RSS is measured whole-child peak, not incremental index memory. No hidden exact fallback; exact verification is outside ANN timing.

measurement.process_peak_rss_scope: whole benchmark child including dataset, database, exact oracle, index and queries; not marginal index memory
